fields.name: air_carrier_name
fields.description: Legal or operating name of the air carrier.

fields.name: certificate_holder_number
fields.description: FAA certificate-holder identifier.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Marketing or operating flight number for the released leg.

fields.name: aircraft_tail_number
fields.description: Registration or tail number of the assigned aircraft.

fields.name: aircraft_type
fields.description: Aircraft fleet or type designator.

fields.name: origin_airport_code
fields.description: IATA or ICAO code for the departure airport.

fields.name: destination_airport_code
fields.description: IATA or ICAO code for the planned destination airport.

fields.name: alternate_airport_code
fields.description: IATA or ICAO code for the dispatch alternate when required.

fields.name: scheduled_departure_at
fields.description: Scheduled departure timestamp with time zone.

fields.name: dispatch_release_number
fields.description: Unique identifier for the dispatch release.

fields.name: release_status
fields.description: Draft, authorized, amended, cancelled, or superseded release status.

fields.name: release_amendment_number
fields.description: Sequence number for a release amendment or redispatch.

fields.name: dispatcher_name
fields.description: Aircraft dispatcher exercising operational-control responsibilities.

fields.name: dispatcher_certificate_number
fields.description: FAA aircraft-dispatcher certificate number.

fields.name: pilot_in_command_name
fields.description: Pilot in command jointly responsible for preflight planning and release.

fields.name: dispatch_authorized_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the aircraft dispatcher authorized the flight.

fields.name: route
fields.description: Planned route of flight.

fields.name: planned_fuel_quantity
fields.description: Total planned dispatch fuel in the stated unit.

fields.name: reserve_fuel_minutes
fields.description: Planned reserve expressed in minutes at the applicable consumption basis.

fields.name: takeoff_weight
fields.description: Planned takeoff weight.

fields.name: weather_summary
fields.description: Current and forecast weather considered for the route and airports.

fields.name: notam_summary
fields.description: Material notices and facility irregularities considered for release.

fields.name: operational_control_exception
fields.description: Unresolved condition requiring delay, amendment, redispatch, or cancellation.

fields.name: regulation_citations
fields.description: Applicable current regulatory citations, including 14 CFR Part 121 subparts T and U.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Evidence-based readiness status; not a substitute for dispatcher or pilot authority.
